text:
The functions $f\colon \Nat \to \Nat$ and $g \colon \Nat \to \Nat$
given by
\begin{align*}
  f(n) & = 2n \text{ and}\\
  g(n) & = 2n+1
\end{align*}
respectively enumerate the even natural numbers and the odd natural
numbers. But neither is !!{surjective}, so neither is an enumeration
of $\Nat$.
